parent_channels.name: Temporal Passage and Emergence

subchannels.name: Daylight, Night, and Stilling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bright daytime opens and extends, then night covers the scene and settles into stillness.
subchannels.active_motifs: extended forenoon `ض ح و:B001/m01`; clear forenoon brightness `ض ح و:B005/m01`; night and darkness `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; night settling into stillness `س ج و:B001/m01`; daylight opening `ن ه ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Forenoon supplies both duration and radiance, while night supplies darkness and `سَجَىٰ` supplies the act of becoming still. The lexical opening of daylight completes a cycle in which illumination expands, darkness arrives, and motion subsides.

subchannels.name: Firstness, Laterness, and Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sequence begins, reaches a later phase, may be deferred, and turns back toward its outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: first position or onset `ء و ل:B001/m01`; later or subsequent state `ء خ ر:B001/m01`; deferment `ء خ ر:B002/m01`; return to outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`; backward movement `ق ه ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Firstness and laterness establish ordered phases. Deferment lengthens the interval, while return to an eventual end and backward motion give that order a reversible shape rather than a static before-after contrast.

subchannels.name: Coming into Being and Disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something absent enters existence, is encountered as real, and is brought into view or speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: origination after nonbeing `ح د ث:B001/m01`; existent entity `و ج د:B002/m01`; manifestation and showing `ح د ث:B006/m01`; sudden incident `ح د ث:B005/m01`; initial emergence `ء و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Beginning marks entry into a phase, occurrence marks entry into reality, existence makes the new thing available to encounter, and disclosure makes it publicly perceptible. A sudden incident is the disruptive form of the same emergence process.

subchannels.name: Freshness and Early Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A life or phase remains close to its beginning and carries the freshness of recent arrival.
subchannels.active_motifs: youth and recentness `ح د ث:B002/m01`; newly delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; fresh beginning or early youth `ر ب ب:B009/m02`; first phase `ء و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recent birth, youth, and firstness converge on a scene whose defining state is proximity to origin. Freshness is therefore temporal as well as bodily.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Things occupy phases, move through ordered succession, and become manifest after absence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The day-night sequence extends into reversal, ontological emergence, fresh life, and sudden incident.

parent_channels.name: Orientation, Search, and Passage

subchannels.name: Straying and Gentle Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler departs from the intended course and is gently directed back toward the road, purpose, or truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: deviation from the way `ض ل ل:B001/m01`; gentle direction to road or truth `ه د ي:B001/m01`; course, manner, and intended direction `ه د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Deviation supplies the displaced participant, guidance supplies the directing action, and the course or manner supplies the route that makes correction intelligible. The scene works equally as road-finding and restoration of purpose.

subchannels.name: Hidden, Lost, and Found
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object disappears from view or memory, becomes hard to locate, and is recovered through finding.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment or disappearance `ض ل ل:B002/m01`; lost object `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; forgotten object `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; finding and locating `و ج د:B001/m01`; directionless lost creature `ع ي ل:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Disappearance, loss of location, and loss from memory are distinct ways an object becomes unavailable. Finding reverses each condition, while the directionless creature gives the search a mobile participant.

subchannels.name: Forward Motion and Agility
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving body rises lightly, advances from the front, and proceeds on foot.
subchannels.active_motifs: light rising or swift advance `ق ل ي:B001/m01`; pedestrian movement `ن ع م:B012/m01`; leading front `ه د ي:B003/m01`; rear or hindpart `ء خ ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lightness initiates advance, the leading front gives it orientation, walking realizes the passage, and the hindpart establishes the axis along which forward movement can be recognized.

subchannels.name: Swaying, Support, and Delayed Pace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A weak or burdened walker advances slowly, sways, and may depend on companions for support.
subchannels.active_motifs: swaying gait `ع ي ل:B003/m01`; supported swaying walk `ه د ي:B008/m01`; delayed progress `ي ت م:B004/m01`; composed unhurried bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; overpowering impediment `ع ي ل:B009/m01`; weak or heavy participant `ه د ي:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Weakness and impediment slow the traveler; bodily swaying shows the unstable gait; reliance on others supplies a walking mechanism; and composure converts slowness from mere incapacity into measured bearing.

subchannels.name: Farewell, Retreat, and Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler departs with farewell, may reverse course, and finally joins a sheltering destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: farewell at departure `و د ع:B003/m01`; night travel `ل ي ل:B002/m01`; backward retreat `ق ه ر:B005/m01`; return toward an end `ء و ل:B002/m01`; joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Farewell begins the journey, night supplies its setting, retreat reverses its direction, and return gives the movement an endpoint. Refuge closes the passage by gathering the traveler into a protected place.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A participant moves relative to a course, loses or recovers orientation, and reaches either a destination or retreat.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral guidance opens into physical finding, gait, front-rear orientation, farewell, and refuge.

parent_channels.name: Care, Need, and Provision

subchannels.name: The Orphan Received into Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child lacking a protector is found, sheltered, and raised under continuing care.
subchannels.active_motifs: orphaned child `ي ت م:B001/m01`; finding the vulnerable person `و ج د:B001/m01`; sheltering another `ء و ي:B001/m02`; gradual nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Orphanhood names the broken protective relation, finding brings the child into view, sheltering restores place and belonging, and gradual nurture turns a moment of rescue into sustained care.

subchannels.name: Poverty Changed into Sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person in need receives enough resources and capacity to leave dependence behind.
subchannels.active_motifs: poverty and need `ع ي ل:B001/m01`; poor nourishment `ع ي ل:B004/m01`; wealth or independence `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; sufficiency and useful adequacy `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; material capacity `و ج د:B003/m01`; good condition `ن ع م:B001/m01`; state or circumstance `ء و ل:B007/m01`; need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Poverty and inadequate nourishment define the initial circumstance. Wealth, capacity, and practical sufficiency are distinct outcomes: possession increases, need falls, and the person becomes able to stand without dependence.

subchannels.name: Request, Grant, and Gentle Reception
subchannels.scene_or_process: A requester names a need, seeks a gift, receives a grant, and is not driven away by harsh speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: asking and seeking `س ء ل:B001/m01`; desired object `س ء ل:B002/m01`; fulfillment of a request `س ء ل:B003/m01`; giving `ع ط و:B002/m01`; solicitation for a gift `ع ط و:B005/m01`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; affectionate present `ه د ي:B004/m01`; harsh rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The requested object gives asking a goal, solicitation initiates transfer, giving and the affectionate present answer it, and fulfillment completes it. Harsh rebuke is the rejected counter-action that would break this exchange at its opening.

subchannels.name: Stewardship against Coercion and Neglect
subchannels.scene_or_process: A responsible holder governs and repairs what is under care instead of abandoning, ignoring, or overpowering it.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship and responsible possession `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; governance and reform `ء و ل:B004/m01`; abandonment `و د ع:B001/m01`; neglect or omission `ي ت م:B003/m01`; refusal to touch or attend `س ج و:B004/m01`; coercive domination `ق ه ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship and governance establish responsibility for another's condition. Abandonment, non-attendance, and neglect withdraw that responsibility, while coercion converts it into harmful power. Repair is the positive operation that opposes both failures.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Vulnerability is encountered and answered through shelter, nurture, provision, and responsive giving rather than neglect or rebuke.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The surface sequence of rescue and command expands into a full economy of guardianship, sufficiency, fulfilled requests, and anti-neglect.

parent_channels.name: Household, Estate, and Custody

subchannels.name: Household, Dependents, and Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household head gathers family and followers, maintains dependents, and assigns service for their needs.
subchannels.active_motifs: household and retinue `ء و ل:B003/m01`; dependents `ع ي ل:B002/m01`; service and handing what is needed `ع ط و:B003/m01`; labor placed at another's disposal `و د ع:B009/m01`; gathered multitude `ر ب ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The household supplies the social container, dependents supply those maintained within it, and service supplies the repeated transfer of labor and necessities. The multitude motif scales the same relation from one family to a gathered group.

subchannels.name: Foster Parent and Ward
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young dependent from an earlier household is received by a foster parent or nurse and raised as a ward.
subchannels.active_motifs: stepchild or ward `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; foster parent, nurse, or caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; orphaned child `ي ت م:B001/m01`; youthful recent age `ح د ث:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Youth and orphanhood describe the ward's vulnerability, while the paired ward-caregiver senses supply a replacement relation of nurture. The scene centers on social incorporation rather than biological descent.

subchannels.name: Bride, Spouse, and Marital Independence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman moves from singleness into marriage, is conducted to a spouse, and gains a recognized household position.
subchannels.active_motifs: bride conducted to her spouse `ه د ي:B006/m01`; married or self-sufficient woman `غ ن ي:B005/m01`; marriage as protection from singleness `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; woman apart from a husband `ي ت م:B005/m01`; personal beauty or excellence `خ ي ر:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Singleness supplies the initial social state, bridal conduct supplies the transition, marriage supplies the new bond, and marital sufficiency names its protective or independent outcome. Beauty enters as a personal quality within that marital scene.

subchannels.name: Estate Repair and Directed Labor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A holder directly manages an estate, repairs its condition, and deploys labor to keep it productive.
subchannels.active_motifs: direct management of an estate `س ج و:B005/m01`; estate ordering and repair `ء و ل:B004/m02`; repair, completion, and oversight `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; labor made available for a task `و د ع:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Direct management identifies the setting, ordering supplies administrative control, repair restores the estate's condition, and deployed labor carries the work into practice.

subchannels.name: Deposit and Safekeeping
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is handed over, held under another's care, maintained, and returned at a later time.
subchannels.active_motifs: entrusted deposit `و د ع:B005/m01`; custodial oversight and repair `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; ordered estate keeping `ء و ل:B004/m02`; deferred transfer `ء خ ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Deposit creates the custodial relation, oversight preserves the entrusted object, estate ordering keeps it within an accountable arrangement, and deferment explains why possession and final transfer occur at different times.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: People, property, and dependents are gathered into durable relations of maintenance, service, guardianship, and entrusted keeping.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 93:3, 93:5, and 93:11 `رَبُّكَ` and `رَبِّكَ`, 93:6 and 93:9 `يَتِيمًا` and `ٱلْيَتِيمَ`, and 93:8 `عَآئِلًا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Care expands from the orphan into family organization, foster relations, marriage, estate labor, and deposit custody.

parent_channels.name: Covenant, Assent, and Power

subchannels.name: Pact, Truce, and Protected Entrant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties suspend conflict through a pact and extend protected standing to a person entering their domain.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant or pact `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; truce and mutual cessation `و د ع:B004/m01`; protected entrant or asylum seeker `ه د ي:B007/m01`; captive under another's control `ه د ي:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The pact binds the parties, truce names the cessation it produces, and protected status applies that bond to a vulnerable entrant. The captive sense marks the neighboring condition in which protection and control must be distinguished.

subchannels.name: Acceptance and Mutual Pleasing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aversion is removed, acceptance is established, and two parties make their approval reciprocal.
subchannels.active_motifs: acceptance opposed to displeasure `ر ض و:B001/m01`; abundant or sought satisfaction `ر ض و:B002/m01`; mutual accord `ر ض و:B003/m01`; active pleasing of another `ر ض و:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Acceptance supplies an inward state, sought satisfaction makes it a goal, pleasing makes one party act toward the other, and mutual accord closes the relation bilaterally.

subchannels.name: Obedience, Attachment, and Surety
subchannels.scene_or_process: A trusted subordinate is attached to a principal through willing obedience, affection, or guarantee.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedient trusted person `ر ض و:B006/m01`; loving attached person `ر ض و:B006/m02`; guarantor or surety `ر ض و:B006/m03`; lord or principal `ر ب ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The principal supplies the relation's authoritative pole. Obedience realizes it behaviorally, attachment realizes it affectively, and surety realizes it as an obligation undertaken for another.

subchannels.name: Coercion, Contest, and Cessation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents drive, seize, or overpower one another until conflict is restrained by cessation.
subchannels.active_motifs: coercive domination `ق ه ر:B001/m01`; victory in contest `ع ط و:B007/m01`; overcoming a rival `ر ض و:B005/m01`; expulsion or driving out `ق ل ي:B002/m01`; stealthy snatching `ن ه ر:B006/m01`; armistice `و د ع:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Driving and snatching initiate dispossession, contest turns it into reciprocal struggle, and coercion fixes a victor over a subdued party. Armistice is the social mechanism that interrupts this chain without requiring either side's annihilation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social relations are stabilized through pact, consent, protection, and surety, or ruptured through coercion and hostile dominance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Satisfaction unfolds into bilateral accord, legal guarantee, protected status, truce, and contested victory.

parent_channels.name: Voice, Dialogue, and Public Memory

subchannels.name: Question, Answer, and Mutual Consultation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants ask one another, answer affirmatively, exchange news, and reach an agreed response.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal questioning `س ء ل:B004/m01`; affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`; renewed speech or news `ح د ث:B003/m01`; mutual accord `ر ض و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reciprocal questioning opens the exchange, renewed speech supplies its content, affirmation answers it, and mutual accord gives the conversation a shared outcome.

subchannels.name: Telling the Benefaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A received good is made visible by being recounted as news.
subchannels.active_motifs: narrated speech `ح د ث:B003/m01`; manifestation and showing `ح د ث:B006/m01`; bestowed benefaction `ن ع م:B001/m02`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; lordly giver `ر ب ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Benefaction supplies the content, the giver supplies its relational source, narration turns it into speech, and manifestation lets the spoken good become publicly perceptible.

subchannels.name: Conduct Becoming Public Memory
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's course of action is repeatedly discussed until it becomes a remembered story or reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: becoming an anecdote or public account `ح د ث:B004/m01`; course and manner `ه د ي:B002/m01`; lapse or omission `ي ت م:B003/m01`; gathered public `ر ب ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Conduct supplies the subject of talk, a lapse supplies a memorable deviation, the gathered public repeats it, and repeated speech converts the person or event into an enduring anecdote.

subchannels.name: Interpretation as Return to Meaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is carried back to its intended sense under learned direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: interpretation by return to meaning `ء و ل:B002/m02`; speech or report `ح د ث:B003/m01`; directed course of discourse `ه د ي:B002/m01`; learned teacher or sage `ر ب ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A report presents language that can travel away from its intended point. Interpretation returns it to that point, while the learned guide supplies the disciplined course by which the return is made.

subchannels.name: Song and Exchanged Verse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A voice performs melody or verse and directs the composition toward another person, who may answer in kind.
subchannels.active_motifs: singing and melody `غ ن ي:B003/m01`; directed poem or poetic exchange `ه د ي:B011/m01`; spoken composition `ح د ث:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech provides verbal content, singing gives it performed sound, and poetic direction gives it an addressee. Exchange turns the performance into a reciprocal verbal encounter.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech moves between participants, discloses what matters, and can persist as interpretation, reputation, song, or remembered account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The command to recount expands into dialogue, public reputation, learned interpretation, and performed verse.

parent_channels.name: Residence, Ease, and Composure

subchannels.name: Shelter and Agreeable Abode
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person joins a shelter, remains there, and finds the place sufficient and agreeable for habitation.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`; lasting residence `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; inhabited abode `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; agreeable place and pleasant stay `ن ع م:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Refuge supplies entry, residence supplies duration, the abode supplies location, and agreeableness turns mere occupancy into a fitting home.

subchannels.name: Rest, Softness, and Quiet Bearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Effort subsides, the body or material yields without resistance, and the participant holds a calm, dignified posture.
subchannels.active_motifs: repose and ease `و د ع:B002/m01`; softness and refined comfort `ن ع م:B002/m01`; calm bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; eyelid stillness `س ج و:B001/m04`; flexibility and yielding `ع ط و:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repose removes exertion, softness and flexibility remove resistance, eyelid stillness gives the calm a bodily sign, and composed bearing makes comfort socially visible as dignity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A participant settles into a fitting place or bodily state and gains stability, comfort, and quiet bearing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Shelter becomes both a physical abode and a manner of settled softness, flexibility, and dignity.

parent_channels.name: Weather, Water, and Navigation

subchannels.name: Layered Cloud, Soft Wind, and Green Persistence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clouds gather and linger, a soft moist wind moves beneath them, and vegetation remains green.
subchannels.active_motifs: layered raincloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; lingering weather `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; soft south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Layering gives the cloud mass, lingering gives it duration, and the soft wind gives the weather motion without violence. The green plant is the durable terrestrial outcome of that sustained atmosphere.

subchannels.name: River, Current, and Opened Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Abundant water cuts through land, opens a channel, and continues as a broad current.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing river `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; opening and widening a channel `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; abundant gathered water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; exposed daylight `ض ح و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Abundant water supplies the material, opening and widening supply the geomorphic action, and the river is the stable path produced by that action. Daylight exposes the channel as an open feature of the land.

subchannels.name: Calm Sea and Maritime Command
subchannels.scene_or_process: A captain directs travel across a calm sea beneath night and cloud.
subchannels.active_motifs: still sea `س ج و:B001/m02`; captain of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; cloud overhead `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; travel by night `ل ي ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sea stillness supplies navigable conditions, night supplies the travel setting, cloud supplies the changing sky, and the captain supplies organized direction across the water.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Air, cloud, light, and flowing water form an environment through which land, vegetation, and travelers are sustained or directed.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Night stillness and daylight open into cloud layers, south wind, river cutting, persistent greenery, calm sea, and maritime command.

parent_channels.name: Food and Material Transformation

subchannels.name: Thickening and Coagulation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A liquid or paste loses fluidity, gathers into a denser mass, and can be used as a prepared substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: liquid curdling or congealing `ء و ل:B005/m01`; thick syrup or paste `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; tightly bound knot or mass `ر ب ب:B016/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Curdling supplies the transition, syrup or paste supplies the dense material state, and the tight knot supplies the endpoint of cohesion. Together they describe consolidation from fluidity to a bound mass.

subchannels.name: Frying, Boiling, and the Prepared Meal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is exposed to heat, releases or absorbs liquid, thickens into a dish, and is served as a meal.
subchannels.active_motifs: frying on a pan `ق ل ي:B004/m01`; meat altered by heat `ق ه ر:B002/m01`; hot-stone dairy and flour dish `ق ه ر:B003/m01`; morning meal `ض ح و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Frying provides direct pan heat, heated meat shows moisture leaving under fire, and the hot-stone mixture shows boiling and stirring into a finished preparation. The morning meal gives the transformed food its serving context.

subchannels.name: Grinding, Washing, and Polishing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard or alkaline implement abrades residue from a surface until the object becomes clean or bright.
subchannels.active_motifs: hard grinding stone `ق ه ر:B004/m01`; cleansing alkali or ash `ق ل ي:B006/m01`; polishing a blade `ح د ث:B007/m01`; polishing a heart through admonition `ح د ث:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The stone supplies mechanical abrasion, alkali supplies chemical cleansing, and polishing supplies the brightened outcome. The heart sense preserves the same removal-of-rust mechanism while transferring it from metal to moral interiority.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Materials change through thickening, heat, abrasion, washing, and polishing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Roots heard in sequence, lordship, hatred, power, and narration also describe a practical workshop of pastes, cooked food, grinding, cleanser, and polish.

parent_channels.name: Holding, Covering, and Carrying

subchannels.name: Vessels and Clustered Contents
subchannels.scene_or_process: A container gathers arrows, lots, drink, or stacked provisions and preserves their ordered mass.
subchannels.active_motifs: leather container or quiver `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; gathered lots or arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; drink-maturing vessel `ء و ل:B010/m01`; stacked provisions in a container `ق ه ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The leather case gathers discrete shafts or lots, the drink vessel holds liquid through time, and the provision container fixes food in stacked order. Their common operation is bounded keeping.

subchannels.name: Wrapping, Shrouding, and Concealment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is extended over an object or body, protects what lies beneath it, and removes it from view.
subchannels.active_motifs: covering with a cloth `س ج و:B002/m01`; protective outer garment `و د ع:B006/m01`; burial beneath view `ض ل ل:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering supplies the immediate action, the outer garment supplies a protective layer, and burial completes concealment by placing the covered body beyond ordinary sight.

subchannels.name: Carrier, Bier, and Supporting Frame
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rigid frame bears a singular load and presents a leading or projecting part for movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrier or bier `ء و ل:B008/m01`; structural timbers or carrying tool `ء و ل:B008/m02`; singular unmatched object `ي ت م:B002/m01`; leading projection or arrowhead `ه د ي:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Timbers form the supporting frame, the bier gives that frame a carrying function, the singular object supplies its load, and the leading projection gives the assembly a directed front.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Objects are kept together, protected from exposure, or borne by a supporting frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical senses form a material system of storage vessels, clustered contents, shrouds, protective cloth, carriers, and projecting supports.

parent_channels.name: Herds, Wildlife, and Ritual Gifts

subchannels.name: Herd, Grazing, and the Stray
subchannels.scene_or_process: A herd grazes early, depends on an owner, produces breeding stock, and risks losing animals to the open waste.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; livestock `ن ع م:B005/m01`; early grazing `ض ح و:B003/m02`; stray animal `ض ل ل:B005/m01`; directionless stray `ع ي ل:B008/m01`; breeding male retained for the herd `و د ع:B008/m01`; motherless animal `ي ت م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Herd and livestock establish collective ownership, early grazing establishes routine, and the retained male sustains reproduction. Straying breaks the owner-animal relation, while motherlessness creates the animal form of lost care.

subchannels.name: Offering and Sacrifice
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock is selected, transferred toward a sacred destination, and slaughtered as an offering.
subchannels.active_motifs: ritual offering sent to the sanctuary `ه د ي:B005/m01`; sacrificial animal `ض ح و:B004/m01`; livestock fit for offering `ن ع م:B005/m01`; transfer as gift `ع ط و:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Livestock supplies the object, selection as a sacrificial animal gives it ritual status, transfer directs it to the sanctuary, and giving explains the offering relation.

subchannels.name: Wildlife, Lure, and Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wild animals move between exposed ground, concealed dens, and mountain refuge while a hunter attempts to draw them out.
subchannels.active_motifs: ibex or deer seeking mountain refuge `ء و ل:B009/m01`; male hyena `ع ي ل:B007/m01`; lure placed at a burrow `خ ي ر:B006/m01`; refuge and defensive gathering `ء و ي:B001/m01`; small wild creature `ق ه ر:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The den and mountain provide two forms of refuge, the wild animals supply the mobile participants, and the lure attempts to reverse concealment by forcing emergence into exposed ground.

subchannels.name: Ostrich Form and Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ostrich supplies a visible body pattern that is transferred to tools and landmarks, then to the image of a group scattering in flight.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`; ostrich-shaped structures and markers `ن ع م:B007/m01`; ostrich flight as group dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The bird is the concrete model, shape analogy transfers its body to built or natural forms, and the flight expression transfers its motion to a defeated or dispersing group.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals are gathered, grazed, lost, sheltered, bred, hunted, or transferred as offerings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human vulnerability and guidance extend into pastoral ownership, wildlife refuge, sacrifice, bird form, and herd dispersal.

parent_channels.name: Goodness, Choice, and Flourishing

subchannels.name: Benefit and Excellence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or thing is repaired toward a useful condition and recognized for goodness, merit, or beauty.
subchannels.active_motifs: beneficial good `خ ي ر:B001/m01`; excellence and merit `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; good condition `ن ع م:B001/m01`; repair and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repair produces a sound condition, benefit describes its practical value, excellence describes its comparative merit, and good condition names the flourishing result.

subchannels.name: Selection and the Desired End
subchannels.scene_or_process: A chooser identifies a desired outcome, compares alternatives, and settles on the option that brings satisfaction.
subchannels.active_motifs: choosing or seeking the better option `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; desired object `س ء ل:B002/m01`; outcome toward which a matter returns `ء و ل:B002/m01`; acceptance of the result `ر ض و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Desire supplies a goal, comparison supplies alternatives, choice directs action toward one of them, outcome reveals what the choice becomes, and acceptance closes the process.

subchannels.name: Disposition Cultivated into Virtue
subchannels.scene_or_process: An innate disposition is gradually trained and softened until it displays refined excellence.
subchannels.active_motifs: natural temperament `س ج و:B003/m01`; gradual nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; cultivated excellence `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; softness and refinement `ن ع م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Temperament supplies the starting nature, nurture supplies repeated formation, softness marks responsiveness to training, and excellence is the stable character produced.

subchannels.name: Blessing, Increase, and Delight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefaction is enlarged until it produces abundant satisfaction and delight.
subchannels.active_motifs: bestowed blessing `ن ع م:B001/m02`; increase or intensification `ن ع م:B010/m01`; delight and solace `ن ع م:B013/m01`; blessing or favor `ر ب ب:B016/m03`; abundant satisfaction `ر ض و:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Favor initiates the good, increase enlarges it, delight is its experienced effect, and abundant satisfaction is the settled outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A beneficial state is recognized, chosen, cultivated, increased, and received with satisfaction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Evaluative goodness becomes a process involving selection, temperament, nurture, increase, and delight.

parent_channels.name: S1. Quantity, Praise, and Assent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Small grammatical forms regulate quantity, evaluation, and affirmation within discourse.
parent_channels.active_motifs: approximating or quantifying particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; praise construction `ن ع م:B003/m01`; affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The particle frames an amount or frequency, the praise form assigns positive value, and the affirmative form commits the speaker to a proposition. Their shared scene is discourse-level stance rather than concrete reference.

parent_channels.name: S2. Names and Appellations
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Lexical material is detached from ordinary description and assigned as a personal, geographic, poetic, or conventional name.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Mount Radwa `ر ض و:B007/m01`; feminine personal names `ر ض و:B007/m02`; Layla and a wine appellation `ل ي ل:B004/m01`; Aylan as name or title `ع ي ل:B006/m01`; named persons, places, or stars `ن ه ر:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs share the act of designation: a root-derived form becomes a stable identifier for a person, place, object, or celestial marker rather than a transient description.

parent_channels.name: S3. Cowrie Shell Ornament
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Small white shells are taken from the sea and hung on an object as decoration.
parent_channels.active_motifs: marine cowrie shell `و د ع:B007/m01`; suspended shell ornament `و د ع:B007/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The sea supplies the material object, its small white form supplies visual appeal, and suspension converts the shell into an ornament.

parent_channels.name: S4. Lots, Projectiles, and the Stick Game
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Handled shafts are gathered in a case, selected or projected, and echoed by a game in which one stick strikes another.
parent_channels.active_motifs: clustered lots or arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; quiver or lot container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; stick-striking game `ق ل ي:B005/m01`; arrowhead or leading point `ه د ي:B003/m02`; grasping by hand `ع ط و:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The container gathers the shafts, the hand selects and handles them, the point gives directional projection, and the stick game reproduces the same striking geometry in play.

parent_channels.name: S5. Singularity and Otherness
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An existent stands apart from peers because it lacks a match or is classified as other.
parent_channels.active_motifs: singular unmatched entity `ي ت م:B002/m01`; other or non-first entity `ء خ ر:B001/m02`; existent thing `و ج د:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Existence supplies the entity, otherness distinguishes it relationally, and singularity marks the stronger condition in which no peer or counterpart remains.
